purpose: Form INC-9 is used to submit a declaration from each subscriber to the memorandum and each first director named in the articles, as required for the purposes of clause (c) of sub-section (1) of section 7.
who: Each of the subscribers to the memorandum and each of the first directors named in the articles
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Identify each subscriber to the memorandum.
Identify each first director named in the articles.
Prepare the declaration in Form No. INC-9.
Submit the declaration by each subscriber and first director.
checklist: Verify first directors named in the articles
watch: Ensure the declaration is submitted by each required subscriber and first director.
